first_review.label: ambiguous
first_review.reason: The test sets div.contentEditable = "true" under jsdom 22, which implements neither contentEditable nor isContentEditable, so only an implementation that reads the expando property `contentEditable === "true"` passes. The common `isContentEditable` or `getAttribute("contenteditable")` checks fail, and nothing in the description, spec or base code picks the check.
first_review.clarification: isEditableTarget detects contenteditable elements by checking `element.contentEditable === "true"` (the jsdom test environment does not implement isContentEditable or reflect the contenteditable attribute).

second_review.label: ambiguous
second_review.reason: Ignoring editable targets follows from exported isEditableTarget, but jsdom does not implement contentEditable/isContentEditable, so only an implementation reading the expando `el.contentEditable === "true"` passes; the idiomatic `isContentEditable` or `getAttribute('contenteditable')`/closest('[contenteditable]') would fail under jsdom.

apps/web/modules/bookings/lib/bookingShe.resolution: Disagreement (convention vs behavior) resolved by Jo, 2026-11-26.
